paragraphs: In the morning, align requirements with product and research teams and translate the user journey into a structure. At midday, create wireframes and visual drafts, trying several color and spacing options. In the afternoon, review interaction details with frontend developers and confirm motion and responsive behavior. Before leaving, review user-testing feedback and add issues to the next iteration.

In short, they turn functionality into a usable interface. They organize flows, create wireframes, define standards, refine interactions, support user research, and collaborate with frontend developers. Combining analysis with craft, they work on the front line of product experience.
